common_filters: Small reviewed concepts use explicit synonym normalization and implication rules from data/derived/browse.json; this UI does not infer new mathematical facts.
manual_selection: OR within one group, AND across groups, with all conditions satisfied by the same algorithm view.
semantic_search: Longest non-overlapping aliases identify dimension-specific concepts. Each recognized concept is an independent AND condition; remaining words are full-text conditions.
advanced_tags: Preserve all precise facts in the engine and complete profile. Hide duplicate common IDs and coarse parent UI choices for oracle order, generic feedback quality and generic target convexity when equivalent common entries exist. Keep finer objects, interfaces, blocks and conditions.
counts: Each option count is a distinct setting count under every other group and semantic/full-text condition, evaluated using compatible views.
zero_results: Report a current filter conflict, compute the smallest set of selected conditions whose removal restores a documented match, and show the resulting setting count. Never conclude that the mathematical setting does not exist.
